name: The marine commander

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: The inquiry crosses to Theramore and Commander Samaul.
description: The harbor account points toward Commander Samaul in Theramore. The lead concerns Kul Tiras marines who travel from Theramore to Menethil on leave; Elling’s name is the sign that earns Samaul’s confidence. The inquiry crosses the sea again, from damp northern docks to a fortified port built on Dustwallow’s marshland. It follows a military posting, not a proven escape route for Varian.
